show.description: is an intense romantic psychological thriller. The story follows Param, a struggling yet sincere artist, and Amrita, a powerful but deeply unstable CEO. What begins as admiration for his art slowly turns into obsession, control, and manipulation. As love blurs into madness, Param is trapped in a dangerous game of identity, sacrifice, and survival, where escaping the past becomes the only way to reclaim his freedom and start over.
